name: refund_customer
description: Refund money to a customer for one of their orders. This moves money: only call it when the customer explicitly asks for a refund and has given the order ID, the amount and a reason. Refunds above 1000 USD are not allowed. Always pass the same idempotency_key when retrying the same refund.

customer_id.description: Customer ID in the form CUST- followed by digits, e.g. CUST-1001.

order_id.description: Numeric order ID that belongs to the customer, e.g. 123.

amount.description: Refund amount in USD as a number with at most two decimals, e.g. 25.5.

reason.description: Short reason for the refund, in the customer's words.

idempotency_key.description: Unique ID for this refund operation (8-128 letters, digits, '-' or '_').
